additional_context: FHIR-40278 is a later Published/Persuasive same-family issue for the same EvidenceReport author target. FHIR-31867 later deprecated and removed EvidenceReport from core for R6. Current source/fhir.ini has no active EvidenceReport or Citation resource entry, source/history.html lists EvidenceReport as removed, and source/clinicalreasoning-evidence-and-statistics.html says Citation moved to the EBM IG and EvidenceReport was replaced by a Composition profile there.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. There is no current in-scope core StructureDefinition or active build entry where the FHIR-34883 change can or should be applied.
